title: Address to Coordinates: Lat and Long Lookup
description: Turn any address into WGS84 latitude and longitude with Address to Coordinates — a map pin you can copy anywhere. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, 350 Fifth Avenue in New York — the Empire State Building — resolves to about 40.7484, -73.9857, the pair every mapping system on earth can use.
quick_answer: Address to Coordinates looks up a full or partial address and returns its WGS84 latitude and longitude with a pin on the map. Type the address, press look up, and copy the coordinates — the universal format that maps, spreadsheets, GPS devices and other tools all speak.

faq: How accurate is it?

The geocoder resolves the address against open map data; accuracy follows the address's completeness and the data's local quality. Always eyeball the pin — a rooftop in a mapped city, a village centre in sparse country.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
Yes — typing an address shares nothing about where you are. Your own position is only used if you separately ask a tool for it.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Names and boundaries vary by source, language and date — disputed areas most of all. This tool reports the open data's view; other maps may differ honestly.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
No. Lookups run against the geocoding service for the address you typed; your browser's location is a separate permission this lookup does not need.
Which coordinate system?
WGS84 latitude/longitude — the system GPS and web maps use. Other datums exist; this is the universal one.
The address is not found.
Add detail: house number, town, postcode, country. Ambiguity is the usual cause, and more of the address is the usual cure.
Reverse — coordinates to an address?
The Coordinates to Address tool runs this lookup backwards.
Coordinates came back with only 2 decimals.
Shorter pairs are coarser matches — the geocoder is reporting the precision the address earned. Add detail to the address to earn more decimals.
Can I enter the address in another language?
Geocoders accept many languages and local scripts, with quality varying by region. The returned coordinates are language-free either way.
Is latitude or longitude first?
Latitude first in the pair this page returns — the mapping convention. Swapped pairs are the field's classic error; the pin reveals it instantly.
